Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Stimulate cells (e.g., macrophages or fibroblasts with LPS, TNF, or wounding), then profile chromatin accessibility and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) binding at days to weeks after washout. Test whether AP-1 motif-containing enhancers stay open or primed, and whether AP-1 occupancy persists, compared with naive cells.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation at different timepoints (dTAG/AID)
ideas.description: Use degron-tagged FOS/JUN to remove AP-1 either during the initial stimulus or only during the later memory phase. If the memory is encoded by AP-1, depleting it during the stimulus should prevent the memory. If AP-1 maintains the memory, depleting it later should erase it. Readouts are accessibility and the faster secondary-response transcription.

ideas.title: Secondary-challenge transcriptional response assay
ideas.description: Give cells a primary stimulus, rest them, then re-challenge them. Measure nascent transcription (PRO-seq/TT-seq) and RNA-seq to quantify faster or stronger induction of genes at AP-1-bound loci. Correlate the size of the memory effect with the level of retained AP-1 binding and chromatin marks (H3K27ac, H3K4me1).

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome tracking of lineage-traced memory
ideas.description: Use single-cell RNA+ATAC with AP-1 motif activity inference (chromVAR) and clonal barcoding or live reporters (AP-1 activity reporter) to follow whether AP-1 history is inherited by daughter cells. Test whether past AP-1 activity predicts future accessibility and response across divisions, separating heritable states from transient noise.

ideas.title: Targeted epigenome editing and site-specific perturbation
ideas.description: Mutate or CRISPR-block individual AP-1 motifs at candidate memory enhancers, or use dCas9 to recruit AP-1 or chromatin remodelers (BAF) to naive loci. Test whether the site is necessary and sufficient for establishing persistent accessibility and primed responses, and whether remodeler inhibition (BRG1) uncouples AP-1 binding from the memory.
